answer: The defence rests on land registry title tenure with deed chain: a title held in the registry with an unbroken deed chain. Forging 345 of these means building 345 separate deed chains from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The reef test is the price tag: 345 fakes mean 345 payments. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The meadow signal is visible to every grader, and the velvet ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
